_comment: Pinned model files for the R4 probe. setup-models.mjs fetches them once from Hugging Face into ext/models/ (gitignored) and checks sizes and SHA-256; the extension itself never uses the network. Revisions checked 2026-11-03.

models.textOnlyConfig: Removes vision_config and audio_config from the local config.json, so Transformers.js 4.3.2 loads only the text model (its MultimodalEncoder loads an encoder only when the config has that section).
